As to what concerns your map you have a valid point. You've waited weeks so feel free to message any Map Developer if you have a lot of time waiting. That one thread that was made was for other people who submit their maps and are bugging Map Developers 4 hours after its submission haha

replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body:
I think it's a matter of when we believe someone is ready to be a map developer, not when there is a need. That latter will only lead to issues internally.

A map developer needs to be active on the forums, helping contribute to maps. They must also know how to properly write YAML config for most gamemodes. All this in addition to have the skills necessary for good map building!
